definition: Various methods for the evaluation for machine translation have been employed.
details: This article focuses on the evaluation of the output of machine translation, rather than on performance or usability evaluation.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. And that is Evaluation of machine translation — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
